learningGoals: Understand that every single thing around us has a name. 🌍
Identify naming words for people in our daily lives (like 'boy', 'teacher', 'mom'). 👩‍🏫
Recognize naming words for places, animals, and things around them. 🏫🐶🍎
Categorize simple words into the correct group: Person, Place, Animal, or Thing. 🗂️
keyVocabulary: Noun (The grammar term for a naming word) 📚
Naming Word (A word that gives a name to something) 🏷️
Identify (To spot or find the naming word) 🔍
teachingTips: I Spy Nouns: While driving or walking, play 'I Spy' but specifically ask for a person, place, animal, or thing. For example, 'I spy an animal that goes woof!' 🚗👀
Label the House: Use sticky notes to write simple nouns (door, bed, cup) and stick them on the objects together. It makes reading real and fun! 🏷️🚪
Storytime Detectives: While reading their favorite bedtime story, pause and ask your child to point out one person and one thing on the page. 📖🔦
Grocery Sorting: After shopping, ask your child to help name the items you bought. Remind them that all the fruits, vegetables, and boxes are 'Things'! 🛒🍎

funActivities.title: Noun Scavenger Hunt 🗺️
funActivities.description: Give your child a small basket and ask them to find one 'Thing' that is soft, one 'Thing' that is hard, and a picture of a 'Person'. This active play reinforces the concept beautifully!

funActivities.title: The Noun Sorting Bowls 🥣
funActivities.description: Write simple words on slips of paper (dog, park, dad, ball). Create four bowls labeled Person, Place, Animal, and Thing. Have your child pull a slip and drop it into the right bowl.

funActivities.title: Draw Your Nouns 🎨
funActivities.description: Fold a piece of paper into four squares. Label them Person, Place, Animal, and Thing. Ask your child to draw their favorite noun in each box (like Mom, Zoo, Cat, and Toy).
